verdict: Leads are coming in, but cost per lead doubled and key buildout is overdue.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 127 leads from Meta at an average cost per lead of $6.19 — but in the most recent week, that cost per lead surged 107% while lead volume grew only 16%, meaning spend is scaling faster than results. The awareness campaign driving most of that spend ($670 of $787 total) is delivering volume at a significantly lower efficiency than before. Separately, ten planned buildout milestones — including landing pages, conversion tracking, search campaigns, and CRM setup — remain undelivered since July through September, which means we cannot yet verify how many of those 127 leads are converting to booked appointments. Those overdue items are being worked through as the immediate priority, and as they come online you should see both better lead quality visibility and lower cost per lead.

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead doubled in the last week while the awareness campaign scaled spend — efficiency is declining.
watch_item.fix: Campaign targeting and budget allocation are being reviewed this week to bring cost per lead back in line before spend increases further.
